name: Accell Group
note: Dutch bicycle group (Lapierre, Raleigh, Haibike, Batavus, Koga, Winora, Ghost, Babboe). Taken private in 2022 by a consortium around investment funds advised by KKR (96.90% of shares at the June 2022 delisting). In August 2026 an Amsterdam court declared the Dutch parts of Accell Group bankrupt and Cycles Lapierre filed for judicial reorganisation in France (Cycling Weekly, 13 August 2026), so ownership is in flux.
